column4: Sugeeswara  Wickramasinghe  Foundation

to  participate  in  social,  cultural  and  economic
development of the country;
to  take  measures  to  protect  and  to  maintain  the
discipline and cultural values of the people;
to give assistance to develop worships places;
to establish information technology centers for the
advancement of scientific studies;
to work towards to protect and develop all rights of
women and children;
to  assist  in  the  development  of  educational,
religious,  cultural,  aesthetic  and  sports  facilities
without any deference to race, religion or cast;
to  promote  peace,  goodwill,  understanding  and
co-operation among all communities and people of
Sri Lanka;
to  assist  needy  school  children  to  enable  them  to
continue  their  education;  and
to liaise and co-ordinate with other local and foreign
institutions which have similar objects.
